label: made up for the demo; brain v1.0 cause list, signed by two role-played senior experts (A1)

causes.label: The setpoint is just off (turn the dial)
causes.fixRoute: Technician turns the dial once, at most 1 degree, logged
causes.tenantSolution: We adjusted the setting for your area.

causes.label: Morning start-up runs too cold
causes.fixRoute: Senior manager changes the start-up schedule

causes.label: Core box held at minimum airflow
causes.fixRoute: Senior manager with the controls contractor
causes.tenantSolution: We adjusted the air box for your area.

causes.label: Thermostat in the wrong spot after a fit-out
causes.fixRoute: Moved back to the spot on the fit-out drawing, with the tenant's OK
causes.tenantSolution: Our contractor will move the wall thermostat back to the spot on your approved fit-out drawing, with your OK.

causes.label: Sun heat on the west glass
causes.fixRoute: Blinds tip now; lasting shading is the AOM's call
causes.tenantSolution: Lower the blinds in the afternoon.

causes.label: Zoning or air balance after a fit-out
causes.fixRoute: Specialist air balancing; outside help or money goes to HQ (A3)
causes.tenantSolution: A specialist will balance the air on your floor.

causes.label: West box fully open for hours (capacity limit)
causes.tenantSolution: We are looking at the air supply for your floor.
